# @three-ws/forge

> Text/image/sketch to a textured, rig-ready 3D GLB in one call. The three.ws Forge generation SDK: free TRELLIS lane, pay-per-call USDC tiers over x402, and auto-rigging.

@three-ws/forge is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/forge`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-forge/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-forge/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-forge/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-forge/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
